message.text:
The s3presign Runner keeps presigned S3 attachment URLs from going stale.

It runs every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup in server/server.go:129 via startBackgroundRunners, which instantiates the runner at lines 161–171.

Presigned URLs expire after five days. The runner refreshes them when fewer than four days of validity remain. It also runs once immediately on startup before the twelve-hour ticker begins.

h01.

**s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:129`**

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` keeps S3 attachment links from going stale by re-presigning URLs via `CheckAndPresign`, which scans S3 attachments and updates `Reference` when the current presigned URL is no longer valid for the next four days (presigned URLs expire after five days; see `internal/storage/s3/s3.go`).

The recurring schedule is defined as:

```26:27:server/runner/s3presign/runner.go
// Schedule runner every 12 hours.
const runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12
```

It is wired into server startup in `Server.Start()`, which calls `startBackgroundRunners`; that function creates the runner, runs it once immediately, then starts it on a goroutine with the 12-hour ticker:

```129:129:server/server.go
	s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
```

```161:169:server/server.go
	// Create and start S3 presign runner
	s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
	s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
```
